Summary: Municipal Administrator Can Register Field Workers
Description:
h2. User Story

As a Municipal Administrator,
I want to register Field Workers area-wise,
So that complaints can be assigned to the responsible worker based on city and area.

h2. Description

Implement functionality that allows the Municipal Administrator to create Field Worker accounts.

Each Field Worker must belong to exactly one city and one area within that city.

Only Municipal Administrators should be able to manage Field Workers within their own city.

h2. Acceptance Criteria

* Municipal Administrator can create Field Workers.
* Worker belongs to exactly one city.
* Worker belongs to exactly one area within that city.
* Field Worker can log in successfully.
* Proper authorization is enforced so Municipal Administrators can manage only their own city workers.
* Area-wise Field Worker details are available for complaint assignment.

h2. Definition of Done

✓ Field Worker registration API implemented.
✓ Registration UI completed.
✓ Area-wise Field Worker assignment implemented.
✓ Validation and authorization completed.
✓ Field Worker can successfully log in.
✓ Swagger/OpenAPI documentation updated.
✓ Unit testing completed.
✓ Code reviewed and merged.
✓ Approved by the Product Owner (Team).
